issues.finding: The source treats successor x union {x} as an injection on every arbitrary inductive set I. The stated axioms have not imposed Foundation, so I may include non-well-founded members on which distinct inputs have the same successor. The axiom still supplies a Dedekind-infinite subset: the successor closure of the empty set inside I.
issues.proposed_resolution: Apply the successor injection and its proper-range argument to the closure of the empty set inside I; use that Dedekind-infinite subset for the subsequent algebra construction. Preserve the frozen source and record this as a bounded prose correction.

translation_treatment: The target scopes the successor injection to the closure inside I while preserving the source's formulas, their order, and the later definition of omega. The distinction between arbitrarily many sets and one infinite set, the finite-number induction proof, and the stage principle remain intact.
